close_reason: Beads IDs in section headers are cross-references, not TODO comments. Removing them would lose traceability. Opinion-only finding — no action.
description: Comments like '(PKIX-vxf)', '(PKIX-gry)', '(PKIX-gmv)', '(PKIX-8ae)' etc. scattered throughout pkix-path/src/lib.rs reference beads issues. Once those issues are closed these become dead references that explain neither the why nor the what to a future contributor. Either replace with prose explaining the design rationale, or remove. A future contributor reading the code has no beads access context.
title: stale beads IDs in source comments become dead references
